question: In which year did India won their first Olympic gold medal in hockey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1928**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India won its first Olympic gold medal in hockey in the year 1928** during the Amsterdam Olympics.
 
• The Indian hockey team defeated the **Netherlands (host nation)** in the final with a score of **3-0** to secure the gold medal.
 
• The victory marked the beginning of **India's dominance in field hockey**, as the team went on to win six consecutive Olympic gold medals from **1928 to 1956**.
 
• **Dhyan Chand**, one of the greatest hockey players in history, played a pivotal role in this victory by scoring **two goals** in the final match.
 
• This was the first time India participated as an independent hockey team, symbolizing its emergence as a global powerhouse in the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dhyan Chand's Legacy:**

 
 
• **Dhyan Chand**, widely known as the "Wizard of Hockey," scored a total of **14 goals** in five matches during the 1928 Olympics.
 
• His birthday, **29th August**, is celebrated as **National Sports Day** in India to honor his contributions to Indian hockey.
 
 
 
• **India's Dominance in Hockey:**
 
 
• India won **six consecutive Olympic gold medals** in hockey from **1928 to 1956**, remaining unbeaten during this period.
 
• During these years, India scored a total of **178 goals** while conceding only **seven**, showcasing its unparalleled dominance in the sport.
 
 
 
• **Other Olympic Gold Medals:**
 
 
• India has won a total of **eight Olympic gold medals** in hockey. These victories came in **1928, 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, 1964, and 1980**.
 
• The last Olympic gold medal in hockey was achieved during the **1980 Moscow Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **Field Hockey in the Olympics:**
 
 
• Field hockey was introduced in the Olympics in **1908**, but India participated for the first time in **1928**.
 
• India's early success in hockey helped popularize the sport across the country.
 
• In recent decades, nations like **Netherlands, Germany, and Australia** have emerged as strong competitors in the sport.
 
 
 
• **Important Points:**
 
 
• The **1928 victory** was India's first major international achievement, instilling a sense of pride and unity during the colonial period.
 
• Post-independence, players like **Balbir Singh Sr.** and **Leslie Claudius** contributed to India's continued success in hockey.
 
• Efforts to revive Indian hockey include initiatives like the **Hockey India League** and grassroots development programs.
 
• India's **bronze medal win** in men's hockey at the **2021 Tokyo Olympics** marked a significant step in the sport's revival.
